name: Asa
source:
Rhea's youngest childhood friend. He wants to be a cool, suave lady-killer, but (to his embarrassment) he has never had a girlfriend before. Even more humiliating, the only girl interested in him is Luca's nine-year-old sister. He has a lot of strange phobias, including spiders, toads, and acorns


(Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/this-world-unknown/]website[/url])
